gold_sql:
SELECT
  p.*,
  ST_Distance(
    ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.172048 39.935946)',4326)::geography,
    p.geometry::geography
  ) AS distance,
  elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(
        p.geometry::geography,
        ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.172048 39.935946)',4326)::geography,
        1300
      )
  AND leisure = 'park';

```sql
WITH park_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.172048 39.935946)'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
nearest_park AS (
  SELECT 
    p.geometry AS park_geom,
    ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, park_geom.geom) AS distance_meters
  FROM 
    parks p,
    park_geom
  WHERE 
    ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, park_geom.geom, 1300)
  ORDER BY 
    distance_meters
  LIMIT 1
),
raster_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Value(rast, ST_Transform(nearest_park.park_geom, 4326)) AS elevation
  FROM 
    public.dem_us,
    nearest_park
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(rast, ST_Transform(nearest_park.park_geom, 4326))
)
SELECT 
  nearest_park.distance_meters AS distance_to_park,
  raster_analysis.elevation AS park_elevation
FROM 
  nearest_park,
  raster_analysis;
```
